tools.description:
Read inbox, history, and recipients; send, acknowledge, or reply on this server only. Message recipients require a current local attachment; message transport never uses Mesh peers. Legacy scope='fleet' requests return feature_disabled. Messages expire 24 hours after created_at. Writes use an attached local work cycle.
The public inputSchema is a permissive transport envelope (names only); all conditions below are enforced by the server with compact structured errors.
Arguments (field? means optional; Type? means nullable): action:"send"|"read"|"ack"|"reply"|"history"|"recipients"; text?:string(0..16384)? (default=null); target?:string(1..120)? (default=null); message_hash?:string(1..128)? (default=null); mode?:"notify"|"ack"|"alert"? (default=null); require_reply?:boolean (default=false); alert?:boolean (default=false); limit?:int (>=1; <=100; default=20); cursor?:string(0..512)? (default=null); detail?:"summary"|"full" (default="summary"); namespace?:string(1..120)? (default=null); task_id?:string(1..120)? (default=null); scope?:"local"|"fleet" (default="local").
The server rejects unknown fields, invalid types, values, bounds and alternatives.
Conditions: ALL_OF(IF action=="send" => requires(text) | IF action=="ack" => requires(message_hash) | IF action=="reply" => requires(message_hash,text)).
Runtime rules: send requires non-null text; message_hash must be absent or null. ack requires non-null message_hash; text must be absent or null. reply requires both text and message_hash non-null. read/history/recipients require both text and message_hash absent or null; explicit null is accepted (non-null values forbidden).; Mesh scope defaults to local; scope=fleet is accepted as transport input but returns feature_disabled; recipients are resolved in the local attachment and messages expire after 24 hours.; For send/reply, nullable mode defaults to notify; mode=alert sets alert and require_reply. Either alert=true or require_reply=true forces final mode=alert even when mode=notify or mode=ack. mode=ack is a delivery mode, distinct from action=ack. Send mode defaults to notify. mode=notify marks read_at automatically on first recipient display, so acknowledged=true means read/handled and does not prove an explicit ACK. mode=ack requires action=ack to set read_at. mode=alert requires a reply to release its reply obligation; action=ack alone does not satisfy it. Either alert=true or require_reply=true promotes notify/ack to alert. first_seen_at records first display; read_at records notify auto-read or explicit ACK; replied_at records actual reply. Repeated ACK is idempotent and creates no new message.; Local send routes are exclusive: use target=<local public_name> with namespace/task_id absent, OR namespace + task_id together for the task’s current local owners, with target absent/null or broadcast. A partial task pair or a named target combined with a task pair fails input_validation_failed with path/reason/repair hint and outcome=not_committed (no message created). If neither route is specified, the send is a local broadcast (may fail no_active_recipients). reply uses the parent sender and ignores supplied target. For send, missing/null target means local broadcast when no task pair is given..
